blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 14 in June to 8 in September (−42.9%), and it took 4.3% of the city’s 188 sales over the period.
The monthly write-ups singled out Websters Corners for detached houses in July, September (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in June (a buyers’ best bet).

items.t: The City describes Webster's Corners as near the border of Maple Ridge and Mission, just off Dewdney Trunk Road, with a network of mountain-bike trails in the BCIT Woodlot and an active film-production hub. The City publishes no boundary for the neighbourhood or the MLS sub-area: UNVERIFIED as an official boundary.

Nearby areas: Thornhill to the northwest, Whonnock and Ruskin to the east and southeast, Albion to the west, and the City of Mission across the eastern municipal boundary. The guide page's feed mixes the Dewdney Trunk Road acreage stock with a suburban estate pocket on the area's west side.
The housing stock is rural detached homes and acreages along Dewdney Trunk Road, 248 Street, 256 Street, 264 Street and 128 Avenue, and the guide page's four feed cards were all residential detached.

The guide page's route 749 (Ruskin / Haney Place) loop claim was not verified, because route 749's own timetable document was not opened: UNVERIFIED. There is no West Coast Express station in this sub-area.

Zoning base: the zoning schedule in Maple Ridge Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019 lists minimum lot areas of RS-2 0.4 ha, RS-3 0.8 ha or 2.0 ha depending on the zone text, A-1 2.0 ha, A-2 4.0 ha and A-3 8.0 ha — the rural zones that cover this area. Rural properties may be on wells and septic — wells are recorded in the provincial GWELLS database and onsite sewerage must comply with the Sewerage System Regulation, including the 30 m setback from a well unless professional advice is obtained. Confirm any parcel's zone and ALR status per property.

items.t: Pad-rent parks (MHPTA): no manufactured-home park inside Websters Corners was verified; where a Maple Ridge park home is bought instead of a strata unit, pad rent may rise at most once every 12 months, on 3 full months' notice, by no more than the yearly limit plus a proportional amount — 2026 = 2.3% plus proportional, 2027 = 2.2% plus proportional. The highest sales ratio in the city rests on two sales. SnapStats publishes no sub-area medians, so any sub-area "median" quoted for this area is UNVERIFIED.

The area doubles as a film set and a trailhead. The City states Webster's Corners is an active hub for film production in Maple Ridge and features the BCIT Woodlot trail network — production traffic and trailhead parking are recurring features of Dewdney Trunk Road life here, not one-offs.
The one verified catchment on record is the school's own address.

No hospital sits inside the sub-area. The serving facilities are Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, Maple Ridge (24/7 emergency, for Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows), and the Ridge Meadows Urgent and Primary Care Centre at 121 – 11900 Haney Place, open 7 days a week, 9:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. — both in the Town Centre to the west.

items.t: Form B diligence (strata townhomes generally): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. No Form B exists for a Websters Corners acreage house — if a listing here claims strata documents, that is a classification error to resolve before subjects.
Lougheed Transit Corridor: It does not designate Websters Corners parcels.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Websters Corners

items.t: Municipality: City of Maple Ridge, BC. The City describes Webster's Corners as located near the border of Maple Ridge and Mission, just off Dewdney Trunk Road, with a network of mountain-bike trails in the BCIT Woodlot and an active film-production hub. SnapStats lists "Websters Corners" as a sub-area under Maple Ridge.
Main roads and commute: Dewdney Trunk Road is the main east–west road; 248, 256 and 264 Streets run north–south; 128 Avenue runs east–west on the north side. Commute times in minutes: UNVERIFIED.

Transit: route 701 (Coquitlam Central Station / Haney Place / Maple Ridge East / Mission City Station) runs east on Dewdney Trunk Road past this area — most east trips end at Dewdney Trunk Road at 248 Street, and some weekday trips continue non-stop from Haney Place to Mission City Station. Route 749 (Ruskin) timetable details: UNVERIFIED. No West Coast Express station in this sub-area; the nearest are Port Haney / Maple Ridge to the west and Mission City to the east.

Schools physically in the area (Ministry-listed names/addresses only): Webster's Corners Elementary, 25554 Dewdney Trunk Road; Blue Mountain Elementary, 12453 248 Street; Garibaldi Secondary, 24789 Dewdney Trunk Road. SD42 has no middle tier (K–7 / 8–12). Catchment, single-address only: the locator result recorded in the master research for the sample address 25554 Dewdney Trunk Road (Webster's Corners Elementary's own address) is Webster's Corners Elementary (K–7) and Garibaldi Secondary (8–12), with the French Immersion schools shown for that address being programs of choice, not catchment schools. That chain is documented for that one address only and is non-transferable; catchments for other Websters Corners addresses are UNVERIFIED.

Recreation and services: the BCIT Woodlot trail network and the City's film-production note (above); Kanaka Creek Regional Park at the west side; Whonnock Lake Park in Whonnock to the east. No recreation centre or library branch inside this sub-area — Maple Ridge Leisure Centre, 11925 Haney Place, and Maple Ridge Public Library, 130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road, are in the Town Centre. No shopping centre inside this sub-area was verified on a City source: UNVERIFIED; the nearest shopping is in the Town Centre, centred on Haney Place Mall, 11900 Haney Place. Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street (24/7 emergency); Urgent and Primary Care Centre, 121 – 11900 Haney Place, 7 days, 9:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Websters Corners

items.t: Lougheed Transit Corridor — ADOPTED Jan 27, 2026 (City record), far west of this ground: OCP Amending Bylaw No. 7781-2021 was given third reading and adopted Jan 27, 2026 (City news release Feb 4, 2026); the corridor runs from the City's western boundary to the Town Centre at 221 Street — it does not reach Websters Corners, and no lot here is priced on it.

ALR block — full form (Websters Corners farm ground): subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval, and ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Information Bulletin 09, s. 6; Strata Property Act, s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act, s. 21(1)). Residence caps: one principal residence per parcel, maximum 500 m²; a secondary suite only inside the principal residence; one additional residence capped at 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less and 186 m² on parcels over 40 ha. Farm class (BC Assessment) in full three-tier form: $2,500 of gross farm income at 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 plus 5% of the actual value of the area over 4 ha above that; $10,000 under 0.8 ha — applications by October 31.

: Form B (SPA s. 59), provided within 7 days, max $35 plus up to 25¢/page; depreciation reports every five years for stratas with five or more lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2 + Reg 7.01, May 1, 2023 exemptions); a "45+" listing line is NOT a valid age bylaw. No strata of any kind is verified in this sub-area, and Maple Ridge has ZERO verified 55+ strata townhouses.

The film industry is part of this ground's economy, per the City. The City states Webster's Corners is an active hub for film production in Maple Ridge alongside the BCIT Woodlot trail network — whether film rentals move prices or rents here is a question the research puts to Jared, UNVERIFIED as an effect.
Do not extend the chain to any other address.

Most eastbound buses on the main road stop short of here. On route 701, most east trips end at Dewdney Trunk Road at 248 Street; only some weekday trips continue non-stop from Haney Place to Mission City Station — an acreage buyer here is driving, and there is no West Coast Express station in the sub-area.

Acreage here is individual fee-simple parcels trading whole.
Streets, schools and getting around Websters Corners Guide

items.t: Identity: "Websters Corners" is both a City of Maple Ridge neighbourhood name and the board sub-area name — a clean match.

The working description — the rural acreage area along Dewdney Trunk Road at the city's east edge — is a page working scope only, never a boundary citation. Main roads: Dewdney Trunk Road east–west; 248 Street, 256 Street and 264 Street north–south; 128 Avenue east–west on the north side. Nearby: Thornhill northwest, Whonnock and Ruskin east/southeast, Albion west, Mission across the eastern municipal boundary.

SD42 has no middle tier — elementary K–7, secondary 8–12. Settled locator chain, single-address basis only, non-transferable: the recorded SD42 locator result for the sample address 25554 Dewdney Trunk Road (the elementary school's own address) is Webster's Corners Elementary / Garibaldi Secondary; French Immersion schools shown for that address are programs of choice, not catchment schools. Catchments for every other Websters Corners address: unconfirmed.

Transit and services: TransLink route 701 runs east on Dewdney Trunk Road past this area — most east trips end at Dewdney Trunk Road at 248 Street, and some weekday trips continue non-stop from Haney Place to Mission City Station; that claim rests on route 701's own timetable document. There is no West Coast Express station in this sub-area; no City recreation centre or library branch sits inside it (Maple Ridge Leisure Centre, 11925 Haney Place, and Maple Ridge Public Library, 130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road, are in Town Centre to the west).

Plans: the North 256 Street Industrial Lands Area Plan — Council approved the OCP amendments creating a plan area on both sides of 256 Street north of 128 Avenue (about 500 acres, per the City release); the plan establishes future designations and does not itself approve construction. Council adopted updates to the Official Community Plan on November 25, 2025, and the Albion Area Plan update on October 28, 2025; no area plan for Websters Corners was found. Parcel-level ALR, floodplain, well and septic status: unconfirmed.

Suites and added units (Maple Ridge): one secondary suite per lot is permitted in listed zones including A-1, A-2 and A-3, contained within the single detached building, to a maximum of 40% of gross floor area, and not in the Floodplain Area. On ALR parcels the ALR frame below also governs.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Websters Corners than in June?
faq.a: In Websters Corners, listings of houses fell from 14 in June to 8 in September (−42.9%).

faq.q: How big is Websters Corners compared with the rest of Maple Ridge?
faq.a: In September 2026, Websters Corners held 2.0% of the 410 houses listed in Maple Ridge.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Websters Corners from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 8 houses sold in Websters Corners over those 4 months.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Websters Corners?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Websters Corners?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: Are there any condos or townhouses in Websters Corners?
faq.a: The stock is rural detached acreages.

faq.q: How did Websters Corners sell in September 2026?
Which schools serve a Websters Corners address?
faq.a: Check any other address in the locator. Note the guide page omits Blue Mountain Elementary from its school section.

faq.q: Can an acreage home here add a suite or a second dwelling?
faq.a: One secondary suite per lot is permitted in listed zones including A-1, A-2 and A-3 if it sits inside the single detached building, is at most 40% of gross floor area and is not in the Floodplain Area; on ALR land the ALR Use Regulation also applies, and an additional separate residence is allowed only under its s. 32 conditions — and ALR residences cannot be stratified in any case.

faq.q: What major plan affects this area?
faq.a: The North 256 Street Industrial Lands Area Plan, approved by Council as OCP amendments, covers both sides of 256 Street north of 128 Avenue (about 500 acres) at the area's northwest side; it sets future designations and does not itself approve construction — disclose it as a designation change, not a development approval.

faq.q: Are there any townhouses in Websters Corners?
faq.a: The stock is rural detached acreages.

faq.q: Why is there no townhouse stock here at all?
faq.a: On the documented base: the sub-area sits outside the Urban Area Boundary on RS-2 / RS-3 and agricultural zoning (minimum lots from 0.4 ha up to 8.0 ha in the A-3 tier), and ALR residences cannot be stratified — strata townhouse product has no zoning or tenure base here today. Confirm any individual parcel's zone and ALR status per property.

faq.q: A listing here says "townhouse-style" / claims strata documents — what do I do?
faq.a: Treat it as a classification error to resolve before subjects: there is no verified strata in this sub-area, an acreage house has no Form B, and the diligence that applies is title, zoning, ALR status, well records (GWELLS) and septic compliance.

faq.q: Does the Lougheed corridor or the 256 Street plan change my parcel?
faq.a: The Lougheed corridor ends at 221 St and does not reach this ground. The North 256 Street plan changes future designations north of 128 Avenue without approving construction — disclose it as a designation change, not a development approval.
